nodes.name: scrap.ts
nodes.summary: Debug command that dumps all known projects as pretty-printed JSON, wrapped in a Log timing span.

nodes.name: ScrapCommand
nodes.summary: Prints the full Project.list() result as JSON to stdout and stops the Log.Default.time span measuring the scrape.

nodes.name: skill.ts
nodes.summary: Skill debugging commands: list registered skills as JSON, and validate every skill (including invalid ones) against the agentskills.io frontmatter spec with folder-name consistency checks.

nodes.name: SkillCommand
nodes.summary: Parent debug skill command grouping the list and validate subcommands.

nodes.name: ValidateCommand
nodes.summary: Re-validates all skills (via Skill.allIncludingInvalid) against a strict zod frontmatter schema plus name/folder matching, reports every issue to stderr, and fails the command when any skill is invalid.

nodes.name: snapshot.ts
nodes.summary: Snapshot debugging commands: track the current snapshot state, and print the patch or diff for a given snapshot hash.

nodes.name: SnapshotCommand
nodes.summary: Parent debug snapshot command grouping the track, patch, and diff subcommands.

nodes.name: startup.ts
nodes.summary: Prints the process startup timing (performance.now) so callers can measure CLI boot cost.

nodes.name: StartupCommand
nodes.summary: Writes the current performance.now() value to stdout as the measured startup time.

nodes.name: export.ts
nodes.summary: Exports a session (by ID or via an interactive autocomplete picker) as JSON, with an optional --sanitize mode that replaces all sensitive transcript, path, diff, and tool I/O content with structured [redacted:kind:id] placeholders for safe sharing.
nodes.languageNotes: Sanitization preserves the full message structure while substituting typed placeholders keyed by kind and part ID, so exported transcripts stay useful for debugging without leaking file contents or prompts.

nodes.name: ExportCommand
nodes.summary: export [sessionID] command shell: dumps session info plus messages as JSON and delegates to the run generator, which prompts with an autocomplete picker when no ID is supplied.

nodes.name: part
nodes.summary: Redacts a single message part by discriminated type — text, reasoning, file sources and spans, subtask prompts, all four tool states (pending/running/completed/other), patch files, snapshot hashes, and agent sources.

nodes.name: sanitize
nodes.summary: Top-level sanitizer that redacts session info (title, directory, summary diffs, revert data) and maps every message's user system prompt, summary, paths, and parts through the part redactor.

nodes.name: generate.ts
nodes.summary: Generates the OpenAPI specification with x-codeSamples JS snippets injected for every operation and prints it prettier-formatted to stdout; consumed by the SDK build pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Formats through a dynamically imported prettier (babel + estree plugins) so the emitted JSON is byte-identical to the committed openapi.json regardless of later format runs.

nodes.name: GenerateCommand
nodes.summary: Fetches the server's OpenAPI spec, attaches a JS code sample to each operation, formats the result with prettier, and waits for stdout to flush before exit.

nodes.name: github.ts
nodes.summary: The opencode github CLI: install sets up the GitHub agent interactively (app installation polling, provider/model selection, workflow file generation), while run is the GitHub Actions entrypoint that handles issue, PR, comment, and schedule events — exchanging OIDC tokens for app tokens, building prompts from issue/PR context, running the agent, and pushing branches, creating PRs and comments.
nodes.languageNotes: The ~1200-line run handler routes USER_EVENTS (with actor/issueId, supporting reactions and comments) separately from REPO_EVENTS (schedule/workflow_dispatch, log-only output), and branches its git strategy between local and fork PRs.

nodes.name: GithubCommand
nodes.summary: Parent github command grouping the install and run subcommands.

nodes.name: GithubInstallCommand
nodes.summary: Interactive installer: resolves the repo from the git origin remote, polls the opencode API until the opencode-agent GitHub app is installed, prompts for provider and model, writes .github/workflows/opencode.yml, and prints next steps including required secrets or AWS OIDC setup.

nodes.name: GithubRunCommand
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions runner: authenticates via OIDC or GITHUB_TOKEN, routes supported events, builds prompts from issue/PR GraphQL data and comment mentions, runs the agent session, then commits, pushes to new/local/fork branches, creates PRs and comments with share links, and revokes the app token on exit.

nodes.name: extractResponseText
nodes.summary: Extracts the last text part from an assistant response, returning null when only non-text parts exist (signaling a summary is needed) and throwing for truly empty responses.

nodes.name: formatPromptTooLargeError
nodes.summary: Formats a PROMPT_TOO_LARGE error listing each file with its estimated decoded size (base64 length times 0.75).

nodes.name: import.ts
nodes.summary: Imports a session from a local JSON file or a share URL into the SQLite database: fetches ShareNext data (attaching auth headers when origins match), regroups the flat API array into nested messages/parts, and upserts session, message, and part rows.
nodes.languageNotes: The ShareNext API returns a flat [session, message, part, ...] array that must be regrouped by messageID to rebuild the hierarchy local storage expects; inserts use onConflictDoUpdate/onConflictDoNothing so re-imports are idempotent.

nodes.name: ImportCommand
nodes.summary: import <file|url> command shell that resolves the instance context and delegates to runImport with the current project ID.

nodes.name: parseShareUrl
nodes.summary: Extracts the share slug from an https://host/share/<slug> URL, returning null for non-matching URLs.

nodes.name: shouldAttachShareAuthHeaders
nodes.summary: Returns true only when the share URL origin matches the account base URL origin, making it safe to attach account auth headers to the fetch.

nodes.name: transformShareData
nodes.summary: Regroups the ShareNext flat [session, message, part, ...] array into the nested { info, messages: [{ info, parts }] } structure expected by local storage, indexing messages and parts by ID.

nodes.name: mcp.ts
nodes.summary: Full MCP server management CLI: list servers with connection status, run OAuth authentication and logout for remote servers, interactively add servers to opencode.json (comment-preserving via jsonc-parser edits), and debug OAuth connectivity down to WWW-Authenticate headers and token expiry.

nodes.name: McpCommand
nodes.summary: Parent mcp command grouping the add, list, auth, logout, and debug subcommands.

nodes.name: McpListCommand
nodes.summary: Lists configured MCP servers with a status icon per connection state (connected, disabled, needs auth, needs client registration, failed) plus OAuth token hints and the command or URL backing each server.

nodes.name: McpAuthCommand
nodes.summary: Runs the OAuth flow for a remote MCP server (interactive picker when unnamed), surfacing browser-open failures via Bus events and guiding users to add a clientId when the server rejects dynamic client registration.

nodes.name: McpAuthListCommand
nodes.summary: Lists OAuth-capable remote MCP servers with their authentication status (authenticated, expired, not authenticated) and URLs.

nodes.name: McpLogoutCommand
nodes.summary: Removes stored OAuth credentials for an MCP server, chosen directly by name or via an interactive picker showing what is stored (tokens, client registration).

nodes.name: McpAddCommand
nodes.summary: Interactive wizard that collects server name, type, command or URL, and OAuth client details, then writes the server entry into the chosen project or global opencode.json(c) while preserving comments via jsonc-parser edits.

nodes.name: McpDebugCommand
nodes.summary: Deep OAuth and connection debugger: prints stored token/client expiry details, sends a raw JSON-RPC initialize request, inspects WWW-Authenticate on 401s, and probes whether dynamic client registration would be attempted.

nodes.name: models.ts
nodes.summary: Lists available models per provider (opencode providers sorted first), with optional verbose metadata output and a models.dev cache refresh flag.

nodes.name: ModelsCommand
nodes.summary: Optionally refreshes the models.dev cache, then prints provider/model IDs sorted alphabetically (opencode providers prioritized), failing cleanly when a requested provider does not exist.

nodes.name: plug.ts
nodes.summary: The plugin installer command: installs an npm plugin package, reads its manifest to detect tui/server targets, and patches the appropriate opencode config, built around an injectable PlugDeps seam so the flow is testable without process mocks.
nodes.languageNotes: createPlugTask receives a PlugDeps object (spinner, log, filesystem helpers) defaulting to real implementations, letting tests substitute fakes rather than mocking child processes.

nodes.name: createPlugTask
nodes.summary: Builds the install pipeline (install package, read manifest, patch config) as an async task over injectable deps, translating npm registry failures and manifest problems into actionable user-facing messages.

nodes.name: PluginCommand
nodes.summary: plugin <module> command shell that validates the module name, runs createPlugTask with the instance's vcs/worktree context, and sets a non-zero exit code on failure.

nodes.name: pr.ts
nodes.summary: Fetches and checks out a GitHub PR via the gh CLI onto a pr/<n> branch, wires cross-repository fork remotes and upstreams, imports any opencode share session linked in the PR body, and relaunches opencode with that session.

nodes.name: PrCommand
nodes.summary: pr <number> handler: runs gh pr checkout under a local branch name, configures fork remotes for cross-repo PRs, imports a linked share session via the opencode import CLI, and spawns opencode with -s <session> (dying on non-zero exit).
